name: crossloom-env
description: Shows the active CrossLoom environment (cl env show) under the prompt, toasts when it changes, and asks before a crossloom write verb runs on a protected environment.

protectedEnvs.title: Protected environments
protectedEnvs.description: Comma-separated system:stage names (e.g. mwm:dev,wiam-3T:prod) on which a crossloom write verb asks for confirmation first. Empty: never asks; the status line still shows the active environment.
